name: Artifacts
description: Review rendered artifacts beside the active conversation.

tools.name: artifact
tools.title: Artifact
tools.description: Create, update, inspect, and delete rendered conversation artifacts for the desktop UI.

action.description: Artifact operation. Use one of: save, get, list, delete.

artifactId.description: Stable artifact id. Reuse this when updating an existing artifact.

kind.description: Artifact type for save operations. Use one of: html, mermaid, latex.

title.description: Artifact title shown in the chat stub and artifact panel.

open.description: Whether the artifact panel should open after saving. Defaults to true.

artifactType.description: Semantic artifact type such as visual-explainer, visual-plan, diff-review, plan-review, project-recap, slides, architecture, data-table, fact-check, or report.

stylePreset.description: Named visual style preset such as visual-explainer, technical-report, architecture-map, review-matrix, or slide-deck.

styleOverrides.description: Optional style override notes for the artifact, such as theme, accent, density, or notes.

source.description: Optional source metadata describing where the artifact came from.

templateVersion.description: Template or visual default version used to generate this artifact.

slashCommands.name: visualize
slashCommands.description: Create a typed visual explainer artifact. Usage: /visualize <topic or style override>

slashCommands.name: diff-review
slashCommands.description: Create a visual diff review artifact for the current workspace changes.

slashCommands.name: plan-review
slashCommands.description: Create a visual plan review artifact. Usage: /plan-review <plan file or scope>

slashCommands.name: project-recap
slashCommands.description: Create a visual project recap artifact for context switching.

slashCommands.name: slides
slashCommands.description: Create a slide deck artifact. Usage: /slides <topic or source>

skills.title: Artifacts and Rendered Outputs
skills.description: Built-in guidance for conversation artifacts, project artifacts, and rendered output behavior.

skills.title: Visual Explainer Artifact
skills.description: Create typed visual explainer artifacts for /visualize and natural-language visual explanation requests.

skills.title: Diff Review Artifact
skills.description: Create typed visual diff review artifacts for /diff-review and workspace change reviews.

skills.title: Plan Review Artifact
skills.description: Create typed visual plan review artifacts for /plan-review and implementation plan critiques.

skills.title: Project Recap Artifact
skills.description: Create typed project recap artifacts for /project-recap and context-switching summaries.

skills.title: Slide Deck Artifact
skills.description: Create typed slide deck artifacts for /slides and presentation requests.
